notes:
Background: Runeberry is a mid-stage dev-tools company (200-600 engs) building an internal developer platform and search layer across monorepos, CI artifacts, and private packages. Primary ask: high-quality code search + RAG-powered internal helpdesk.

Scale & technical goals:
- Corpus: ~5 TB of code + binaries, expect 400M-800M embeddings after shingling and language-specific tokenization.
- Indexing cadence: nightly full-ish re-index (delta + compaction) plus ad-hoc re-index after major merges; target to complete nightly window in <6 hours.
- Query profile: 150k queries/day (spikey), p95 latency target for retrieval+rerank: <=120ms, reranker budget p95 <=40ms.
- Cost target: cost-per-query (end-to-end) < $0.01 for standard retrieval; willing to accept higher for deep investigations.
- Accuracy: top-5 reranked results must surface correct file/function >=92% on internal eval sets.

Architecture preferences / constraints:
- Hybrid approach: FAISS/HNSW-style ANN for candidate retrieval + small cross-encoder reranker for final scoring. Want Redwood to support routing to a CPU-optimized ANN tier + GPU rerankers.
- Prefers Dedicated for predictable throughput; may consider Private (VPC) for EU-residency sensitive repos.
- Must integrate SSO (SAML) for access to console and admin APIs.
- Audit log retention (1 year) and KMS-backed key management mandatory.

Recent activity (shorthand good for CRM):
- 2026-01-09: Intro call (Maya/Luis). They described nightly reindex pain and poor tail latencies on current vendor. (Gmail thread: thread-CA+-20260109_a1b2c3)
- 2026-01-12: Technical deep-dive with infra + search eng. Discussed sharding strategies, ANN recall, reranker batching. (Fireflies ff_2026-01-12_0821)
- 2026-02-05: Security questionnaire submitted; follow-up on SSO/KMS. Provided security deck (drive link).
- 2026-02-10: Bench plan review — agreed to baseline: 100M vectors, 1 cross-encoder T4-like GPU, validate p95. (Fireflies ff_2026-02-10_1410)
- 2026-02-20: Pricing expectations sync. Expect monthly committed Dedicated nodes if POC meets SLA.

Key quotes / call notes:
- "Nightly indexing is our pain point — if we can shrink the window and keep p95 stable we can consolidate multiple search systems." — Head of Search Eng
- "We need SSO on day one and proof of audit logs." — Security lead

POC scope being requested:
- Index 500M vectors (representative sample) with realistic shingle/tokens.
- Run retrieval+rerank QPS up to 250 rps in bursts, measure p50/p95/p99.
- Validate prefix/KV caching effectiveness and end-to-end cost savings with batching.
- Provide integration pattern for nightly re-index via their CI (we need runbook + sample pipeline).

Decision criteria:
- performance (p95 retrieval+rerank), cost (per-query economics) and operational friendliness (rollouts, tracing, SSO).

Action items / next steps (CRM-style):

- Product to propose reranker autoscaling knobs + batching guidance.

- Schedule Dedicated POC kickoff: target week of 2026-03-22.

Potential blockers summary: budget ask routed to procurement; legal needs data residency appendix for EU repos; CI team requires sample terraform modules for re-index job.

Stability / churn risk: medium — they evaluate multiple vendors focused on vector scale and reranking (Pinecone + self-hosted FAISS + Weaviate).
